budget_items.topic: Green Communities grant cap per town
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Kelly Brown described the annual Green Communities grant maximum per town, with applications due February 7 for the Spring block and April 12 for the Fall block.
budget_items.quote: a maximum of 1 grant per year is granted per town (up to $200k).

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Kelly Brown introduced the new Decarbonization Grants, with larger project funding and a municipal match; receiving one bars other grants for a few years.
budget_items.quote: larger project funding up to $500,000 with 25% municipal match.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Kelly Brown said Lunenburg is eligible for a $200,000 grant for interior non-municipal lighting, with LED lighting still funded at a reduced amount.
budget_items.quote: lunenburg eligible for $200,000 grant (interior non municipal lighting).

budget_items.topic: EV charging funding (EVIP versus Green Communities)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Kelly Brown said EVIP funds EV charging up to a per-station amount and that a project cannot apply to both EVIP and Green Communities.
budget_items.quote: most communities have gone through evip, more specific to ev. up to 7500 per station.
